name: J1 Rikidozan/Neo Japan Pro Wrestling Unified Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Two belts carried together, the J1 Rikidozan title and the Neo Japan Pro Wrestling Heavyweight Championship, reactivated with the blessing of Neo Japan's former head. MASSIVE Akita won them in the CORONATION tournament final at Ryogoku on 3 February 2001 and made his first defense there against Rick Taylor on 24 March, still champion when the record ends.

name: Pan Asia Juniorheavyweight Championship
epitaph: A junior heavyweight championship to be decided by the round-robin Junior Struggle League of May and June 2001, with a final set for Tokyo Budokan on 16 June. Tasogare no Prince led the league when the last results were posted on 21 May; no champion appears in the surviving record.
